decision_rationale: All 14 Wasm execution requirements (WASM-01..14) have implementation with adequate framework and unit-test coverage. Core Wasm infrastructure is solid: CapabilitySet, TimeoutContext, ModuleRegistry, and Host API functions are fully implemented and tested. Benchmark suite passes with zero regressions. Integration testing is deferred to Stage 10 with three documented critical blockers. Path forward is clear and Stage 10 implementation plan is defined. Stage 9 is ready for release pending completion of Stage 10 integration work.
